name: Telekine
summary: Telekine; Universal, Telekinesis; Force shields, kinetic movement, crushing pressure, battlefield control.  Telekine; When you cast a force power, you may push the target 10 ft on a failed save.  Telekine; Your forced movement increases by 5 ft.  Telekine; Once per short rest, when you use Psychic Ward, you may also push the attacker 10 ft.
descriptionMarkdown:
Telekine; Universal, Telekinesis; Force shields, kinetic movement, crushing pressure, battlefield control.

Telekine; When you cast a force power, you may push the target 10 ft on a failed save.

Telekine; Your forced movement increases by 5 ft.

Telekine; Once per short rest, when you use Psychic Ward, you may also push the attacker 10 ft.
